history.title: Our History
history.p1: The formation and development of the Open Joint-Stock Company 'Commerzbank of Tajikistan' as a universal credit organization took place in the conditions of many years of activity in a competitive environment in the domestic banking services market.
history.p2: It began in 2006, when the Limited Liability Company 'Muzaffariyat' was formed, organizing banking activities in the form of a micro-loan organization based on license No. 001-2519 'A' from the National Bank of Tajikistan.
history.p3: In May 2016, the updated team of LLC MDO 'Muzaffariyat' rebranded, renaming the credit organization to LLC MDO 'Fardo'. A month later, the license from the National Bank of Tajikistan for banking operations was updated under number BMT No. 0000062.
history.p4: In October 2017, the credit organization, operating as a limited liability company, was transformed into a joint-stock company, replenishing its charter capital with the help of shareholders (a new shareholder) to a level that allows it to continue its activities as a bank. MDO 'Fardo' was transformed into OJSC 'Commerzbank of Tajikistan', which was granted license No. BMT 0000085 by the National Bank of Tajikistan.
history.p5: The bank's development strategy for the near future is aimed at expanding the scope of non-cash payment systems, improving the technological platform, and introducing innovative products. For example, the 'FAVRI' technological platform allows individuals and legal entities to use a wide range of banking services remotely. By becoming participants in e-commerce, they gained the ability to pay for purchased goods and services via QR code, as well as to carry out many other operations outside the Bank's office.
history.p6: A new and innovative product was the mobile application 'Favri Intiqol', which currently has no analogue in the financial market of Tajikistan. It, being a unified addition to the 'Sberbank Online' application, has no user restrictions: holders of any cards issued by Russian banks can make instant money transfers to the Republic of Tajikistan through it. The development of this innovative technological solution became possible thanks to the bilateral project 'One Gateway - All Russia', which allowed mobile banking to become even more functional, universal, and convenient. Its unique novelty lies in the fact that it can be used by users of any cards of the Russian national payment system, as well as international payment systems.
history.p7: From the first days of its establishment in the credit organizations market, the bank has strived to provide high-quality and accessible financial services to the population, thereby supporting the development of small and medium-sized businesses in the country's regions.
history.p8: Commerzbank, as a socially active bank, today keeps pace with innovative technologies, applying standardized procedures for access to microfinance in its relationships with clients, which helps to minimize possible credit risks.
history.p9: To date, 63 Banking Service Centers and 11 branches operate in the country. In the future, it is planned to open new Banking Service Centers and branches, which will make the Bank even more accessible at the regional level.

whatIsIt.title: What is the individual deposit insurance system?
whatIsIt.p1: The individual deposit insurance system is a set of measures to protect the rights and legal interests of depositors by paying insurance compensation to depositors upon the occurrence of an insured event in credit institutions that are members of the Individual Deposit Insurance Fund.
whatIsIt.p2: The goal of the system is to ensure the financial stability of the Republic of Tajikistan, including maintaining public confidence in the banking system.
whatIsIt.p3: The legal basis for the system is regulated by the Law of the Republic of Tajikistan "On Insurance of Individual Deposits". The Individual Deposit Insurance Fund (hereinafter - the Fund) operates to ensure the effectiveness of the system. The Fund pays insurance compensation, maintains a register of member credit institutions, and manages the collection of contributions.

fundGoals.title: The goals of the Fund are:
items: To protect the rights and legal interests of depositors by paying insurance compensation;
To strengthen public confidence in the banking system of the Republic of Tajikistan;

contactInfo.title: Contact Information:
contactInfo.address: Address: 77/2 Mayakovsky St, Dushanbe, 734025, Republic of Tajikistan

coverage.title: Level and Coverage of the Fund's Insurance Compensation
coverage.p1: Individual deposits are automatically insured and do not require a separate insurance contract from the depositor. The object of insurance is individual deposits in national and foreign currencies, confirmed by bank deposit agreements, salary and pension card accounts, and/or savings books.

notCovered.title: Upon the occurrence of an insured event, compensation for the following deposits is not paid:
items: deposits against which the credit institution has a right of set-off for counterclaims;
deposits obtained through criminal means or seized by a court;
deposits that have worsened the financial condition of the credit institution, according to the National Bank of Tajikistan;
deposits of affiliated persons of the credit institution;
deposits of partners of the audit firm engaged as the auditor;
deposits of individuals holding more than five percent of the credit institution's shares;
deposits placed in foreign branches of the credit institution;
deposits equal to any amount of the depositor's outstanding debt to the credit institution;

compensation.title: Insurance Compensation
compensation.p1: An insured event is the compulsory liquidation of a credit institution by a court decision, which creates an obligation for the Fund to pay insurance compensation.
compensation.p2: Upon the occurrence of an insured event, according to the Law, the amount of compensation for deposits is as follows:
limits: in national currency, not more than 500 (five hundred) calculation indicators;
in foreign currency, not more than 350 (three hundred and fifty) calculation indicators;
compensation.p3: Deposits in national currency are compensated in national currency. Deposits in foreign currency are compensated in national currency at the official exchange rate of the National Bank of Tajikistan on the day of the insured event. Interest on deposits is not compensated by the Fund.

paymentProcess.title: Payment of Insurance Compensation
paymentProcess.p1: After an insured event, the Fund publishes an announcement in the media about the agent bank, location, time, and procedure for accepting claims. The announcement is also posted at the entrance of the agent bank and on the Fund's official website, www.idif.tj.
paymentProcess.p2: Payments begin no later than 14 calendar days after the insured event. Payments are made through an agent bank based on the depositor's application, in cash or non-cash form.
paymentProcess.p3: To receive compensation, a depositor must apply to the agent bank within one year from the date of the insured event and provide the following documents:
documents: Application in the prescribed form (provided at the agent bank);
Power of attorney, if a legal representative is applying on behalf of the depositor.

slides.title: 1. Research the Institution
slides.content: Ensure that the bank where you want to place a deposit is a member of the insurance system and has a Certificate of Membership from the Fund.

slides.title: 2. Check Your Contract
slides.content: Carefully check that your full name, passport details, address, and phone number are correct in the deposit agreement, and always inform the bank of any changes.

slides.title: 3. Remember What Is Not Insured
slides.content: Pledged deposits, deposits obtained criminally, or deposits from affiliated persons are not subject to compensation. A full list is provided above.

slides.title: 4. Don't Worry and Act Calmly
slides.content: You have one year to claim your compensation. Avoid rushing on the first day to prevent long queues. The Fund may extend the application period for valid reasons (illness, emergencies).
